text_plain: Engine oil dipstick tube replacement task with initial setup, removal, installation, manual references, equipment condition, and follow-on tasks.

tools: General mechanic's tool kit: automotive (Appendix B, Item 1)

procedure_steps.text: Remove oil dipstick (5) from oil dipstick tube (4).
Remove oil dipstick tube (4) from engine oil pan (10). Remove and discard O-ring (9).
Install oil dipstick (5) into oil dipstick tube (4).

follow_on_tasks.text: Start engine (TM 9-2320-280-10) and check for oil leaks.

title: Engine Fails To Crank
text_markdown:
#### 1. Engine Fails To Crank
Step 1. Check to see if transmission shift lever is in "N" (neutral) or "P" (park) for M1123 and A2 vehicles.
text_plain: Operator troubleshooting entry for engine fails to crank with ordered checks and maintenance escalation.

troubleshooting.question: What should the operator check when the engine fails to crank?
decision_order: Check battery fluid level and battery connections.
Escalate other causes to unit maintenance.
actions: Place lever in neutral or park if not already set.
Notify unit maintenance if battery issues exist.
